title: The Nvidia Machine Is Self-Sustaining – And Was Already Facing A Tougher Future
gist: Timothy Prickett Morgan argues Nvidia can largely run itself after Jensen Huang's affair-driven resignation (CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO, Harvey Jones named first chairman) amid a Megaspeed export-control scandal, but Huang leaves a company already facing custom-silicon competition, customer friction over open Nemotron models, supply and power constraints, and datacenter backlash.

themes.theme: Huang resignation and Megaspeed export-control scandal

insights.claim: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia president and CEO after revelations of two affairs, one with an executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed International and one with a senior Nvidia executive; CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO.
insights.speaker: Timothy Prickett Morgan
insights.so_what: Abrupt founder-CEO exit at the most valuable AI hardware vendor is a key-person and governance shock.
insights.locator: Well, like most of you on Earth

insights.claim: A sister company of Megaspeed bought $4.8 billion of Nvidia GPU gear between June 2024 and February 2026, and The Information reports Megaspeed and affiliates acquired $7.5 billion in GPU systems since 2023, amid chatter that it channeled systems or remote access to Chinese firms including DeepSeek.
insights.speaker: Timothy Prickett Morgan
insights.so_what: Quantifies potential export-control leakage that could bring legal and regulatory penalties to Nvidia.
insights.locator: There is a lot of chatter

insights.claim: The US Commerce Department had investigated Megaspeed since late 2024, but the probes reportedly stalled as President Trump and Huang grew close, and were moved to the Department of Justice with unclear status.
insights.speaker: Timothy Prickett Morgan
insights.so_what: Political shielding of Nvidia may be fading, raising enforcement risk.
insights.locator: There is a lot of chatter

insights.claim: The author predicts the new Congress sworn in January 2027 will aggressively investigate the Megaspeed affair, with facts gathered and punishments eventually meted out, possibly followed by a presidential pardon if Huang is indicted.
insights.speaker: Timothy Prickett Morgan
insights.so_what: Expect prolonged congressional scrutiny and headline risk for Nvidia through 2027.
insights.quote: the new Congress being sworn in coming January 2027 will be all over this issue
insights.locator: There is a lot of chatter

insights.claim: The author argues that if export controls apply to physical machines, they should logically also cover selling cloud capacity over the wire, a loophole Megaspeed customers like Alibaba may have exploited.
insights.speaker: Timothy Prickett Morgan
insights.so_what: Extending export controls to remote GPU access would further shrink Nvidia's addressable China demand and hit cloud resellers.
insights.quote: if you are putting export controls on physical machines, it only makes sense that you should have export controls on selling capacity from a cloud over the wires
insights.locator: There is a lot of chatter

themes.theme: Governance and leadership transition at Nvidia

insights.claim: Harvey Jones, a former Synopsys CEO, Square Wave Ventures managing partner and Nvidia board member since November 1993, was named Nvidia's first-ever board chairman while the board searches for a permanent CEO; Kress is expected to remain CFO afterward.
insights.speaker: Timothy Prickett Morgan
insights.so_what: Board-level governance change and an open CEO search create succession uncertainty.
insights.quote: This is the first time Nvidia has had a chairman.

insights.claim: Huang, the world's 15th richest person with $145 billion of Nvidia stock before the revelations, forfeits $108 million in share compensation by stepping down and holds a 3.6 percent stake.
insights.speaker: Timothy Prickett Morgan
insights.so_what: A large founder stake and a possible future Huang venture are overhangs worth tracking.
insights.locator: Aside from all of these issues

insights.claim: Because Huang ran Nvidia with 60 top executives reporting directly to him, the author argues the company's operating process is in place and those executives know their jobs, so Nvidia can largely run itself for now.
insights.speaker: Timothy Prickett Morgan
insights.so_what: Near-term execution risk from the CEO exit may be smaller than feared.
insights.quote: If there was a time where Nvidia can largely run itself, it is now.
insights.locator: As for Nvidia, Huang is famous

insights.claim: Nvidia's Rubin and Feynman GPU roadmaps are set to carry the company into 2030, its production is already sold out for 2027, and the author expects 2028 to sell out soon.
insights.speaker: Timothy Prickett Morgan
insights.so_what: Locked-in roadmap and sold-out supply support near-term revenue visibility despite leadership turmoil.
insights.locator: As for Nvidia, Huang is famous

insights.claim: Losing Huang as the AI industry's ambassador and most eloquent voice makes the industry less coherent, and his importance will be tested in a future that was already less certain for Nvidia.
insights.speaker: Timothy Prickett Morgan
insights.so_what: Loss of narrative leadership could weigh on AI sentiment and Nvidia's premium valuation.
insights.quote: the AI industry just got a lot less coherent and eloquent

insights.claim: Hyperscalers, cloud builders and AI model builders are developing custom CPUs and XPU accelerators to wean themselves off expensive Nvidia hardware and run their own models for around half the cost of the Nvidia stack.
insights.speaker: Timothy Prickett Morgan
insights.so_what: Custom silicon at ~50% cost threatens Nvidia's share and margins among its largest customers.
insights.locator: The hyperscalers, cloud builders, and AI model builders

insights.claim: Nvidia's open Nemotron models, which only Nvidia can afford to give away because of its hardware premium, compete directly with the closed models of its largest GPU customers, probably irking them.
insights.speaker: Timothy Prickett Morgan
insights.so_what: Channel conflict with top customers could accelerate their shift to in-house accelerators.
insights.locator: Moreover, Nvidia is championing open source

insights.claim: The author doubts rosy AI spending forecasts for 2029, 2030 and beyond can be met, citing supply-chain constraints on many components and difficulty adding electricity capacity to grids.
insights.speaker: Timothy Prickett Morgan
insights.so_what: Long-dated AI capex forecasts underpinning Nvidia's valuation may be too optimistic.
insights.locator: But even more alarming for those

insights.claim: In the US there is rising public backlash against perceived preferential treatment of datacenter operators, as residential electric bills have risen alongside datacenter proliferation and concern grows over GenAI's societal effects.
insights.speaker: Timothy Prickett Morgan
insights.so_what: Political and regulatory backlash on power costs could slow datacenter buildouts.
insights.quote: It is not a coincidence that residential electric bills have gone up as datacenters have proliferated
